card.title: PANTHER G
card.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy orders.
card.flavorText: The Panther G was a medium tank built and used by the Germans in WWII from 1943 to 1945. The tank was built to counter the Soviet T-34 and is today considered the best tank of WWII, both for its firepower and protection. The Panther G had a crew of 5 (driver, radio-operator/hull machine gunner, commander, gunner, loader),  a main armament of 1x 7.5 cm KwK 42 L/70 and a secondary armament of 2x 7.92 mm MG 34 machine guns.
